mechanism_narrative: Persistent decline in RETAIL_REC over four consecutive weeks (t-3w: -11.6, t-2w: -17.0, t-1w: -18.9, t-0w: -22.9) reflects an established downward trend that will continue into the next four weeks absent a reversal trigger, producing further negative RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined every week for four consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days, or the week-on-week decline rate reverses to positive for two consecutive weeks before day 28.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has recovered from -59.0 (t-2w) to -32.0 (t-0w), signaling return-to-office behavior. This workplace recovery drives commuting-adjacent retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks despite current negative levels.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises more than 20 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 27 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES declines below -40 in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC remains below -15 for all four weeks ahead.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility collapsed from 21.6 (t-2w) to -8.9 (t-0w), indicating weather deterioration or behavioral shift away from outdoor activity. This outdoor-to-indoor substitution will redirect foot traffic to enclosed retail venues, increasing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 0 and remains negative
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined 30.5 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS recovers to positive levels within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase by at least 3 points from t-0w baseline within the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM remains elevated (1.9 at t-0w) while RETAIL_REC declines sharply, indicating consumers are prioritizing essential shopping over discretionary retail. If GROCERY_PHARM sustains above baseline and RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, discretionary retail will remain suppressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -5 or RESIDENTIAL drops below 8, or RETAIL_REC rises above -10 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT stations remain severely depressed at -55.9 (t-0w), indicating ongoing mobility restrictions or public transport avoidance. Sustained transit suppression prevents commuter-driven retail access, keeping RETAIL_REC negative over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has been below -48 for all four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -40 within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 points from t-0w baseline despite TRANSIT remaining below -50.

mechanism_narrative: January 15 marks mid-summer in Sydney with potential for seasonal retail recovery (back-to-school, summer sales). RESIDENTIAL elevation (12.7) combined with improving WORKPLACES (-32.0) creates conditions for retail rebound as outdoor restrictions ease and consumer confidence returns.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES falls below -40 or RESIDENTIAL drops below 8 within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not improve by at least 4 points from t-0w by week 2.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT show divergent recovery patterns (WORKPLACES +27 points vs TRANSIT flat), suggesting remote work adoption is stabilizing. Sustained remote work reduces commuter retail access, keeping RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks despite workplace recovery.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises AND TRANSIT remains below -50
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -40 within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases above -10 for three consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains consistently elevated (7.4 to 14.1 over four weeks) while RETAIL_REC declines, indicating consumers are substituting home-based activities for retail visits. This home-preference behavior will persist, keeping RETAIL_REC negative over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL elevated for all four weeks while RETAIL_REC declined
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below 5 for two consecutive weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises above -10 and sustains for three consecutive weeks.
